info.text:
In August 2020, 4 in 5 US job ads on Indeed hid the pay.

By August 2026, 51.1% of US postings on Indeed listed pay (Indeed Hiring Lab, 3-month average).
A big driver: state laws. Colorado required pay in postings from January 2021, NYC from November 2022, California, Washington and New York State in 2023, more states in 2024 and 2025, and Virginia and Maine in 2026, among others.
The EU gave countries until June 7, 2026 to require pay info in the job ad or before the interview; only 4 of 27 had fully done so by the deadline (Mayer Brown, July 2026).

Sources: Indeed Hiring Lab pay-transparency data (Aug 2026), state labor laws, Axios (June 2021), Mayer Brown (July 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
